sentences.en: The burglar broke into the post office in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 这个窃贼在大白天闯进了邮局。

sentences.en: The burglar gained access to the house through a window.
sentences.zh: 这个窃贼通过窗户进入了这所房子。

sentences.en: The burglar gained access to the house through this door.
sentences.zh: 这个窃贼通过这扇门进入了这所房子。
